architecture_summary: React SPA with neobrutalist design system. Four core surfaces: marketing hero, bento component showcase (buttons, badges, inputs, loaders, tables, sidebar), auth modal overlay, and App shell providing navigation between Hero and Components pages with modal trigger.

tickets.title: Hero & Features Page
tickets.description: Build marketing landing page using thirtyspace_hero_section as primary reference. Neobrutalist style: thick black borders, hard drop shadows, bold typography, high-contrast accent blocks. Include hero headline, subheadline, dual CTA buttons (Get Started triggers auth modal via prop callback, View Components routes to /components), feature grid section highlighting design system pillars.
acceptance_criteria: Matches thirtyspace_hero_section layout and neobrutalist aesthetic
Accepts onOpenAuth prop to trigger AuthModal
Navigates to /components via react-router Link
Responsive: stacks on mobile, grid on desktop
No external UI library; pure Tailwind + inline styles

tickets.title: Components Bento Showcase Page
tickets.description: Single-page bento grid showcasing full component library. Reference screens: thirtyspace_button_showcase, thirtyspace_badge_showcase, thirtyspace_component_showcase_inputs, thirtyspace_loader_showcase, thirtyspace_table_showcase, thirtyspace_sidebar_showcase, thirtyspace_404_navigation_bento_variant. Sections: Buttons (primary/secondary/destructive/ghost variants + sizes), Badges (status/count/pill), Inputs (text/textarea/select/checkbox/radio), Loaders (spinner/dots/bar), Data Table (sortable header, striped rows, action column), Sidebar preview panel. Each section a bordered bento card with heading and live examples.
acceptance_criteria: All six component categories rendered inline (no separate files)
Neobrutalist styling: 3-4px black borders, 6-8px offset hard shadows, no border-radius or minimal
Bento grid layout responsive (1 col mobile, 2-3 cols desktop)
Table has at least 4 sample rows with badges in status column
Loaders animate via CSS keyframes
Interactive states (hover, focus) visible on buttons and inputs

tickets.title: Auth Modal (Login/Register)
tickets.description: Overlay modal with tabbed Login/Register views based on thirtyspace_login_register_mobile. Controlled component: props open (bool), onClose (fn). Fixed backdrop, centered card with thick border and hard shadow. Tab toggle switches between Login (email + password) and Register (name + email + password + confirm). Submit handlers are stubs (console.log). Close on backdrop click and ESC key. Trap focus inside modal when open.
acceptance_criteria: Renders nothing when open=false
Backdrop click and ESC key call onClose
Tab switching preserves separate form state per tab
Inputs use neobrutalist border+shadow style consistent with Components page
Submit button prevents default and logs form data
Accessible: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby set

tickets.title: App Shell with Navigation
tickets.description: Root App component. Top navbar (neobrutalist: thick bottom border, logo left, nav links center, Login button right). Routes: / -> Hero, /components -> Components, * -> 404 page inline using thirtyspace_404_navigation_bento_variant style. Manages authModalOpen state; passes open callback to Hero and navbar Login button. Uses react-router-dom BrowserRouter.
acceptance_criteria: BrowserRouter with three routes wired
Navbar visible on all routes with active-link styling
authModalOpen state lifted here; AuthModal rendered once at root
Login button in navbar and Hero CTA both open AuthModal
404 route renders inline neobrutalist not-found block with link back to /
Imports Hero, Components, AuthModal from correct paths
